summary: Completed frontend UI/integration testing for SkyHop canvas game. All primary flows work: start screen renders with title/instructions/Start button, Start button initiates play, live-score visible and starts at 0, keyboard (Space) and mouse click both cause flaps, rapid-repeat Space presses do not crash, collision & ground fall both trigger Game Over, gameover panel shows final-score/high-score/Play Again + 'Tap or press Space to restart' hint, Play Again resets score to 0, 5+ consecutive restarts work cleanly, Space also restarts after the 450ms cooldown, high score persists across page reloads via localStorage key skyhop_highscore_v1, mute toggle correctly toggles aria-label (Mute/Unmute) during play, and NO console errors were observed across ~60s of gameplay across multiple runs. One functional/UX bug found: the mute-toggle button is covered/intercepted by the Overlay div on the Start and Game Over screens, so users cannot mute except while actively playing. Also, score-increment was not verifiable in headless because the bird cannot be visually piloted through gaps, but the score logic path is present and correct; the live-score updates and increments observably in code — recommend main agent verify manually or add a deterministic seed for future automated coverage.

ui_bugs.issue: The full-screen Overlay div (rendered for Start and Game Over states, absolute inset:0) is rendered AFTER the mute-toggle button in the DOM and therefore stacks on top, intercepting pointer events. On start & gameover screens the mute-toggle cannot be clicked; instead the click bubbles through the Overlay to the game-area onPointerDown handler and triggers flap()/startGame(). Mute only works during active play. Fix: either render the mute-toggle after the Overlay (or give it higher z-index and pointer-events:auto), or move the Overlay before the button.

action_items: Fix mute-toggle stacking so it is clickable on Start and Game Over overlays (raise z-index / render order). Currently clicks fall through the Overlay to the game-area and cause a flap/start.
critical_code_review_comments: SkyHop.jsx: Overlay component is rendered as a sibling AFTER mute-toggle; without a z-index on the button it is covered by the Overlay. Consider z-index:20 + pointerEvents:auto on the mute button or reorder the JSX so overlays are rendered before the button.

onPointerDown flap fires on any click inside game-area including clicks that visually appear to hit the mute button (because the Overlay bubbles). Consider stopping propagation on the Overlay for non-button areas, or ensure the mute button is above the overlay.
Game loop reads mutedRef.current and phaseRef.current correctly (avoiding stale closures) — good pattern.
No pause when the tab is backgrounded; MAX_DT clamp mitigates but pipes still spawn while hidden. Minor.
localStorage read wrapped only by parseInt; would benefit from try/catch for private-mode Safari (edge case).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Game is fully frontend/canvas. Drive via keyboard Space and mouse clicks on [data-testid=game-area]. All required data-testids exist: game-area, start-button, restart-button, mute-toggle, live-score, final-score, high-score, game-title, gameover-title, start-panel, gameover-panel, new-best. High-score key: skyhop_highscore_v1. Bird cannot be visually piloted headlessly, so verifying score increments >0 is unreliable via automation; instead verify score logic by mocking gRef state or by asserting live-score element is present & starts at 0, and by asserting the final-score/high-score elements appear on gameover. Mute-toggle is covered by Overlay on start/gameover — retest after fix by clicking mute on start screen without force=True.
rca of the issue: Overlay layering: In SkyHop.jsx, the mute button is defined before the {phase==='start' && <Overlay/>} and {phase==='over' && <Overlay/>} blocks. Since neither element sets an explicit z-index, HTML stacking order applies and the later-in-DOM Overlay paints above the earlier mute button. Additionally, Overlay covers inset:0 so it also captures all pointer events for that region. Reproduction: open app → hover top-right mute icon → click → nothing happens (aria-label unchanged) and the game starts instead because the click bubbles to game-area onPointerDown → flap → startGame. Mitigation: add style={{ zIndex: 20 }} (or Tailwind z-20) to the mute button OR render Overlays before the mute button OR wrap mute button with pointer-events:auto inside a higher-z-index absolute container above the Overlay.
